name: KGA Claude Config
description: Materializes the shared KGA CLAUDE.md + .claude/ config at the workspace root by fetching the canonical KGA-Life/kga-claude-config repo. Human-developer / CI distribution channel for the KGA integration-API fleet.

claude_config_repo.description: Canonical config repo to fetch CLAUDE.md + .claude/ from.

claude_config_ref.description: Branch, tag, or SHA of the canonical config to materialize. Default 'main' so a config bump propagates on next build; pin to a tag/SHA for reproducibility.
